component.name: FATE
component.summary: Markdown viewer and text editor for technical documents

description.p: FATE (Formatted Article and Text Editor) renders Markdown the way technical documents need: KaTeX mathematics, including multi-line matrices and equations inside headings, Mermaid diagrams, syntax-highlighted code fences, and a live table of contents. A repair layer heals the badly escaped LaTeX that language models and export tools produce before it reaches the screen.

It is also a full text editor. Any text file opens — code, configuration files, logs, scripts, extensionless files — in a CodeMirror editor with syntax highlighting for around 150 languages, code folding, multiple cursors, search and replace, split view and diffs. Files changed on disk reload in place while your buffer is clean, and never over unsaved edits.

Eight themes plus a custom theme builder, a bundled font library with per-file-type overrides, print to PDF with a real preview, tabs with per-tab session restore. Fully offline: no telemetry, no network requests.
